product.name: Reusable Fabric Sweeper
product.source_summary: Owned seller brief and observable product demonstration notes; no reviews, offer, competitor footage, or performance metrics supplied.

audience.persona: Pet owners with dark fabric furniture
audience.context: They notice visible loose hair while preparing the room for guests.
audience.pain: Loose pet hair makes a recently cleaned room look unfinished.
audience.desire: A reusable, easy-to-empty tool for routine touch-ups.

facts.statement: The handheld manual tool gathers visible loose pet hair from woven fabric during the seller's demonstration.
facts.source_locator: Owned product brief, observable product facts, bullet 1
facts.visual_proof: One continuous real-footage pass over a dark woven cushion.

facts.statement: Collected hair moves into an internal chamber.
facts.source_locator: Owned product brief, observable product facts, bullet 2
facts.visual_proof: Open the chamber after the pass and show the collected hair.

facts.statement: The tool uses no disposable adhesive sheets.
facts.source_locator: Owned product brief, observable product facts, bullet 4
facts.visual_proof: Place an empty disposable roll beside the reusable tool without making universal superiority claims.

facts.statement: The tool can be used again after the chamber is emptied.
facts.source_locator: Owned product brief, observable product facts, bullet 5
facts.visual_proof: Empty the chamber and begin a second real pass.

facts.statement: The chamber opens so the collected hair can be removed.
facts.source_locator: Owned product brief, observable product facts, bullet 3
facts.visual_proof: Close macro shot of the chamber opening.

facts.statement: Do not claim that one pass removes all hair or that the tool works on every fabric.
facts.visual_proof: Keep the real surface visible and use qualified language.

facts.statement: Do not use an AI-generated cleaning result as product proof.
facts.visual_proof: Use owned real footage for every performance claim.
